en.s: The Battle of Antioch (8 June 218) was fought between the Roman army of the Emperor Macrinus and his rival Elagabalus, whose troops were commanded by General Gannys, probably a short distance from Antioch. Gannys's victory led to Macrinus's downfall as emperor and his replacement by Elagabalus. Macrinus was elevated to the throne with the support of the Roman army following the assassination of his predecessor, Caracalla, by a disaffected soldier whilst on campaign against Parthia on 8 April 217.

zh.s: 安条克战役于218年6月8日爆发，交战双方是罗马皇帝马克里努斯的军队，以及由甘尼斯将军指挥、支持其竞争者埃拉伽巴路斯的军队。战斗可能发生在安条克附近不远处。甘尼斯获胜后，马克里努斯失去皇位，埃拉伽巴路斯取而代之。马克里努斯此前在前任卡拉卡拉于217年4月8日遭一名不满的士兵刺杀后，得到罗马军队支持而登上皇位。

en.s: The Sacking of Lindisfarne was a Viking raid in AD 793, targeting the monastery on Lindisfarne, an island off the northeastern coast of England. The attack was carried out by Norse seafarers and is often considered the beginning of the Viking Age. The monastery, founded in 635 AD by Saint Aidan, was a major centre of Christian learning in Northumbria.

zh.t: 林迪斯法恩修道院遇袭
zh.s: 公元793年，来自北欧的维京人袭击英格兰东北海岸林迪斯法恩岛上的修道院。这座修道院由圣艾丹于635年创立，是诺森布里亚重要的基督教学习中心。此次袭击常被视为维京时代的开端。

en.t: Edward the Confessor succeeds Harthacnut as king of England
en.s: Harthacnut died on June 8, 1042, and his half-brother Edward succeeded him as king of England. The new reign began that day; the later coronation was a separate ceremony. Edward ruled until his death in 1066.

zh.t: 忏悔者爱德华继承英格兰王位
zh.s: 1042年6月8日，英格兰国王哈德克努特去世，他同母异父的兄弟爱德华继承王位。爱德华的加冕仪式在此后举行，他一直统治到1066年去世。

en.t: Rebel generals proclaim Isaac Komnenos Byzantine emperor
en.s: On June 8, 1057, rebel officers proclaimed Isaac Komnenos emperor at Gounaria in Paphlagonia, in present-day Turkey, while Michael VI still ruled in Constantinople. Isaac later defeated loyalist forces and was crowned in Constantinople on September 1.

zh.t: 反对派将领拥立伊萨克·科穆宁为拜占庭皇帝
zh.s: 1057年6月8日，反对米海尔六世的将领在今天土耳其境内的帕夫拉戈尼亚拥立伊萨克·科穆宁为皇帝。此时米海尔六世仍在君士坦丁堡执政；伊萨克击败皇帝的军队后，于同年9月正式加冕。

en.t: English forces under King Richard I arrive in Acre, joining the already arrived French and German forces of the Third Crusade
en.s: Richard I (8 September 1157 – 6 April 1199), known as Richard the Lionheart or Richard Cœur de Lion (Old Norman French: Quor de Lion) because of his reputation as a great military leader and warrior, was King of England from 1189 until his death in 1199. He also ruled as Duke of Normandy, Aquitaine, and Gascony; Lord of Cyprus; Count of Poitiers, Anjou, Maine, and Nantes; and was overlord of Brittany at various times during the same period.

zh.t: 理查一世率英军抵达阿克，与先前抵达的法国和德国第三次十字军东征部队会合
zh.s: 理查一世（1157年9月8日—1199年4月6日）因其杰出的军事领导能力和战士声望，被称为“狮心王理查”或“狮心理查”（古诺曼法语：Quor de Lion）。他自1189年起担任英格兰国王，直至1199年去世。同一时期，他还统治诺曼底、阿基坦和加斯科涅，兼任塞浦路斯领主、普瓦捷伯爵、安茹伯爵、曼恩伯爵和南特伯爵，并曾在不同时期作为布列塔尼的宗主。

en.s: The battle of Ardres was a battle that took place on 8 June 1351 by forces from the Kingdom of France, led by Édouard I de Beaujeu, near the English-held town of Ardres, in a ditch in a river bend, as a part of the Hundred Years' War. In the battle Beajeau was killed and the English commander, John de Beauchamp was captured.

zh.s: 阿德尔战役于1351年6月8日爆发，是百年战争的一部分。爱德华一世·德·博热指挥法国军队，在英军控制的阿德尔镇附近、河湾的一条壕沟中作战。博热在战斗中阵亡，英军指挥官约翰·德·博尚被俘。

en.s: The Battle of Acajutla was a battle on June 8, 1524, between the Spanish conquistador Pedro de Alvarado and an army of Pipils, an indigenous people, in the neighborhood of present-day Acajutla, near the coast of western El Salvador.

zh.s: 阿卡胡特拉战役于1524年6月8日爆发，交战双方是西班牙征服者佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多与皮皮尔人军队。皮皮尔人是当地原住民，战斗发生在今萨尔瓦多西部海岸、阿卡胡特拉附近。

en.s: The Battle of Ameixial, was fought on 8 June 1663, near the village of Santa Vitória do Ameixial, some 10 kilometres (6.2 mi) north-west of Estremoz, between Spanish and Portuguese as part of the Portuguese Restoration War. In the spring of 1663, the Spanish had undertaken their most successful attack on Portugal, since the beginning of the war. Under command of John of Austria the Younger, son of Philip IV of Spain, the greater part of the south of Portugal was overrun. The important city of Évora was taken on 22 May, opening perspectives for a march on Lisbon, 135 kilometres (84 mi) to the west.

zh.s: 阿梅沙尔战役于1663年6月8日在葡萄牙复辟战争期间爆发，地点在圣维多利亚-杜阿梅沙尔村附近，距埃斯特雷莫什西北约10公里。交战双方是西班牙和葡萄牙。1663年春，西班牙发动了战争开始以来对葡萄牙最成功的一次进攻。西班牙腓力四世之子奥地利的约翰指挥西军，占领了葡萄牙南部大部分地区，并于5月22日攻下重要城市埃武拉，为向西135公里外的里斯本进军创造了条件。

en.s: Wager's Action was fought on 8 June 1708 between a Royal Navy squadron under Charles Wager and a Franco-Spanish convoy under José de Santillán and Jean-Baptiste du Casse as part of the War of the Spanish Succession. It ended in a British victory, with the Spanish losing two treasure galleons and suffering heavy casualties.

zh.s: 瓦格尔海战于1708年6月8日爆发，交战双方是查尔斯·瓦格尔率领的英国皇家海军分舰队，以及何塞·德·桑蒂利安和让-巴蒂斯特·迪·卡斯指挥的法西运输船队。战斗是西班牙王位继承战争的一部分，以英国获胜告终。西班牙损失两艘宝船，并有大量人员伤亡。

en.s: The Battle of Seringham was fought on the island of Srirangam between 1,000 troops of the British East India Company commanded by Stringer Lawrence and a confederacy of French East India Company troops and Chanda Sahib.

en.s: The action of 8 June 1755 was a naval battle between France and Great Britain early in the French and Indian War. The British captured the third-rate French ships Alcide and Lys off Cape Ray, Newfoundland in the Gulf of St. Lawrence. The battle contributed to the eventual war declarations that in 1756 formally began the Seven Years' War.

zh.s: 1755年6月8日的海战发生在法国与英国之间，是法国印第安战争初期的一场海战。英国在纽芬兰雷角附近的圣劳伦斯湾俘获了法国三级战列舰“阿尔西德”号和“吕斯”号。这场海战促成了后来正式宣告开战，并于1756年开始的七年战争。

en.s: The capture of Belle Île was a British amphibious expedition to capture the French island of Belle Île off the Brittany coast in 1761, during the Seven Years' War. After an initial British attack was repulsed, a second attempt under General Studholme Hodgson forced a beachhead. A second landing was made, and after a six-week siege the island's main citadel at Le Palais was stormed, consolidating British control of the island.

en.s: The Battle of Trois-Rivières was fought on June 8, 1776, during the American Revolutionary War. A British army under Quebec Governor Sir Guy Carleton defeated an attempt by units from the Continental Army under the command of Brigadier General William Thompson to stop a British advance up the Saint Lawrence River valley.

zh.s: 特鲁瓦里维耶尔战役于1776年6月8日在美国独立战争期间爆发。圭尔·卡尔顿爵士率领的英国军队击败了威廉·汤普森准将指挥的大陆军部队，后者试图阻止英军沿圣劳伦斯河谷向上游推进。

en.s: The Battle of Mobley's Meeting House (also sometimes called Gibson's Meeting House) was an engagement that occurred during the American Revolutionary War in the Mobley Settlement, Fairfield County, South Carolina during the southern campaign of Lord Cornwallis. On 8 June 1780, a small body of Whig militia led by Colonel William Bratton surprised a gathering point of Tory militia at Mobley's Meeting House, about 6 miles (9.7 km) west of present-day Winnsboro. Many of the Tories tried to escape by descending a steep embankment; this attempt led to more casualties than were caused by the actual firefight.

zh.s: 莫布利聚会所战役（有时也称吉布森聚会所战役）是美国独立战争南方战役期间的一场交战，发生在南卡罗来纳州费尔菲尔德县的莫布利聚居地。1780年6月8日，威廉·布拉顿上校率领一小队爱国派民兵，突袭了托利派民兵在莫布利聚会所的集结点，地点约在今温斯伯勒以西6英里处。许多托利派民兵试图沿陡坡逃跑，因此造成的伤亡比交火本身还多。

en.s: The battle of Cox's Mill was fought between Patriot and Loyalist militias in Randolph County, North Carolina on June 8, 1781. Cox's Mill was the site of a base of operations for the Loyalists under the command of David Fanning. Loyalist scouts informed Fanning of a large force of 160 Patriots under John Collier who were about 10 miles away in pursuit of him.

zh.s: 考克斯磨坊战役于1781年6月8日在北卡罗来纳州伦道夫县爆发，交战双方是爱国派和效忠派民兵。考克斯磨坊是效忠派在大卫·范宁指挥下的行动基地。效忠派侦察兵向范宁报告，有一支由约翰·科利尔率领、共160人的爱国派队伍正在追击，距离约10英里。

en.t: Lakagígar fissure eruption begins in Iceland
en.s: The Lakagígar volcanic fissure in Iceland began erupting on June 8, 1783. The eruption continued into February 1784, releasing gases that killed large numbers of livestock; a severe famine followed. Lakagígar is the fissure, while Laki is the mountain it crosses.

zh.t: 冰岛拉卡吉加火山裂缝开始喷发
zh.s: 1783年6月8日，冰岛拉卡吉加火山裂缝开始喷发，直到次年2月才结束。喷发释放的含氟气体造成大量牲畜死亡，冰岛随后发生严重饥荒。拉卡吉加是火山裂缝的名称，拉基则是它穿过的山。

en.t: June 1789 Speaker of the British House of Commons election
en.s: The June 1789 election of the Speaker of the House of Commons occurred on 8 June 1789. The incumbent Speaker William Wyndham Grenville, who had been in office for only five months, had resigned to take office as Home Secretary. Henry Addington was proposed by the Marquess of Graham and seconded by Thomas Grosvenor.

zh.s: 英国下议院于1789年6月8日选举议长。时任议长威廉·温德姆·格伦维尔仅任职五个月，便辞职出任内政大臣。亨利·阿丁顿由格雷厄姆侯爵提名，托马斯·格罗夫纳附议。

en.s: The Battle of Chełm was fought on June 8, 1794 between Poland and the combined forces of the Russian Empire and Prussia. The Polish were led by Józef Zajączek, the Russo-Prussian forces by Petrowicz Zagriażski and Wilhelm Derfelden. The Russo-Prussian forces consisted of 16,500 soldiers, and 24 cannons, while the Polish general only had about 6,000 soldiers, 14 cannons, and 2,000 peasant soldiers armed with war scythes.Zajączek took in the forested hills 1.5 km away from the city. In the early noon the Russian troops started the attack.

zh.s: 海乌姆战役于1794年6月8日爆发，交战双方为波兰与俄罗斯帝国、普鲁士联军。约瑟夫·扎扬切克率领波兰军队，彼得罗维奇·扎格里亚日斯基和威廉·德费尔登指挥俄普联军。俄普联军有16,500名士兵和24门火炮；波兰军只有约6,000名士兵、14门火炮，以及2,000名手持战镰的农民士兵。扎扬切克在距城1.5公里的林木覆盖丘陵中布阵。中午前后，俄军开始进攻。

en.s: Martin's cruise of 1794 was the only significant French naval operation in the Mediterranean Sea conducted in 1794. In 1793 France had gone to war with Great Britain and a wide coalition of European enemies in the French Revolutionary Wars. Early in the conflict the British had seized the French Mediterranean Fleet and their home port of Toulon, the town enduring a four month siege by French Republican forces in which the fleet was badly damaged.

zh.s: 马丁1794年巡航是法国海军1794年在地中海开展的唯一一次重要行动。1793年，法国在法国大革命战争期间与英国及欧洲多国组成的联盟开战。战争初期，英国夺取法国地中海舰队及其母港土伦；随后法国共和军围城四个月，舰队遭到严重破坏。

en.s: The siege of Mequinenza (15 May to 8 June 1810) saw a 16,000-man Imperial French corps commanded by Louis Gabriel Suchet invest a 1,000-strong Spanish garrison under Colonel Carbon. Mequinenza and its castle were captured by the French after an operation lasting about three weeks. The action occurred during the Peninsular War, which formed part of the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 梅基嫩萨围城战发生于1810年5月15日至6月8日。路易·加布里埃尔·絮歇指挥的1.6万名法帝国军包围了卡邦上校率领的1,000名西班牙守军。经过约三周作战，法军攻占梅基嫩萨及其城堡。这场战斗发生在半岛战争期间，半岛战争是拿破仑战争的一部分。

Voter turnout was 77.0%, although only 24,887 people were eligible to vote. Under the alternating system, elections were only held in five out of the nine provinces: Antwerp, Brabant, Luxembourg, Namur and West Flanders.

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 8 June 1847. The result was a victory for the new Liberal Association, which had been formed the previous year. It won 33 seats to the Catholics' 21, as the latter were split into dogmatic and liberal groups. Voter turnout was 77%, although only 1% of the country's population was eligible to vote.

en.s: The 1848 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 1st Wisconsin Legislature on June 8, 1848. zh.t: 1848年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举

en.s: The Battle of Cross Keys was fought on June 8, 1862, in Rockingham County, Virginia, as part of Confederate Army Maj. Gen. Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson's campaign through the Shenandoah Valley during the American Civil War. Together, the battles of Cross Keys and Port Republic the following day were the decisive victories in Jackson's Valley Campaign, forcing the Union armies to retreat and leaving Jackson free to reinforce Gen. Robert E. Lee for the Seven Days Battles outside Richmond, Virginia.

en.t: Franz Joseph I crowned king of Hungary
en.s: Franz Joseph I was crowned king of Hungary at Matthias Church in Buda on June 8, 1867, following the Austro-Hungarian Compromise. The ceremony formalized his status as Hungary’s king within the new dual monarchy.

zh.t: 弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世加冕为匈牙利国王
zh.s: 1867年6月8日，弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世在匈牙利布达的马加什教堂加冕为匈牙利国王。这场仪式发生在奥匈折衷方案达成后。

en.s: The 1868 Avon by-election was a by-election held on 8 June during the 4th New Zealand Parliament in the Christchurch electorate of Avon. The by-election was caused by the resignation of the incumbent MP William Reeves on 2 May 1868. Reeves had been elected in the 11 March 1867 Avon by-election and after attending the 1867 parliamentary session, he resigned as his business partner had died in late 1867.

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 8 June 1880. In the elections for the Chamber of Representatives the result was a victory for the Liberal Party, which won 74 of the 132 seats. Voter turnout was 67.2%, although only 62,936 people were eligible to vote. Under the alternating system, elections were only held in five out of the nine provinces: Antwerp, Brabant, Luxembourg, Namur and West Flanders. A special election was held on 21 August 1880 to elect a representative for the arrondissement of Oudenaarde following the death of Auguste Devos on 21 July 1880.

zh.s: 比利时于1880年6月8日举行部分大选。在众议院选举中，自由党获胜，赢得132个席位中的74席。投票率为67.2%，但只有62,936人具备投票资格。根据轮替制度，九个省中只有安特卫普、布拉班特、卢森堡、那慕尔和西佛兰德五省举行选举。奥德纳尔德选区代表奥古斯特·德沃于1880年7月21日去世后，该选区于8月21日举行特别选举以选出继任者。

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 8 June 1886. en.s: The Inangahua by-election of 1893 was a by-election held on 8 June 1893 during the 11th New Zealand Parliament in the West Coast seat of Inangahua. The by-election was held because of the bankruptcy of the previous MP Richard Reeves who had won the seat by just one vote. This election saw Robert Stout, a twice former premier, who had been out of parliament since 1887 return under the newly organised New Zealand Liberal Party. Patrick O'Regan would also stand for the New Zealand Liberal Party in later years and won the seat of Inangahua at the New Zealand general election, 1893.

zh.s: 1893年伊南加瓦补选于6月8日举行，选区位于新西兰西海岸，是第11届新西兰议会的一次补选。此前议员理查德·里夫斯因破产失去席位；他曾以一票之差赢得选举。曾两度担任总理的罗伯特·斯托特在1887年离开议会后，这次以新组建的新西兰自由党成员身份重返议会。帕特里克·奥雷根后来也代表新西兰自由党参选，并在1893年新西兰大选中赢得伊南加瓦席位。

en.s: The Advance on Pretoria was a military operation during the Second Boer War. From May–June 1900, Lord Roberts and his force began a strategic offensive from Bloemfontein to Pretoria, with the goal of capturing Pretoria, the capital of the South African Republic (Transvaal) in hopes of ending the war, and forcing the Boers into surrendering.

en.s: The Ontario general election, 1908 was the 12th general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. It was held on June 8, 1908, to elect the 106 Members of the 12th Legislative Assembly of Ontario ("MLAs"). The Ontario Conservative Party, led by Sir James P. Whitney, was elected for a second term in government, increasing its majority in the Legislature significantly. The Ontario Liberal Party, led by Alexander Grant MacKay, continued to lose seats. Allan Studholme became the province's first Labour MLA as the result of a 1906 Hamilton East by-election.

zh.s: 1908年安大略省大选是加拿大安大略省举行的第12次大选，于6月8日举行，选出第12届立法议会的106名议员。詹姆斯·P·惠特尼爵士领导的安大略省保守党再次赢得执政权，并大幅扩大议会多数席位。亚历山大·格兰特·麦凯领导的安大略省自由党继续失去席位。艾伦·斯塔德霍姆在1906年汉密尔顿东区补选中当选，成为该省首位工党议员。

en.s: The 1908 Quebec general election was held on June 8, 1908, to elect members of the 12th Legislative Assembly of the province of Quebec, Canada. The incumbent Quebec Liberal Party, led by Lomer Gouin, was re-elected, defeating the Quebec Conservative Party, led by Pierre-Évariste Leblanc.

zh.s: 1908年魁北克省大选于1908年6月8日举行，选出加拿大魁北克省第12届立法议会议员。由洛默·古安领导的魁北克自由党再次当选执政党，击败皮埃尔-埃瓦里斯特·勒布朗领导的魁北克保守党。

en.s: The Bay of Islands by-election of 1915 was a by-election held on 8 June 1915 during the 19th New Zealand Parliament in the Northland electorate of Bay of Islands. The by-election came about because Vernon Reed's win in the 1914 general election was declared void by an electoral court. The seat was won by William Stewart of the Reform Party. Reed, who was also of the Reform Party, was barred by the court from standing for election for 12 months.

zh.s: 1915年岛屿湾补选于6月8日举行，是新西兰第19届议会北地岛屿湾选区的一次补选。此前选举法院裁定弗农·里德在1914年大选中的当选无效，因此举行补选。改革党候选人威廉·斯图尔特赢得席位。里德也属于改革党，但被法院禁止在12个月内参选。

en.s: The Action of 8 June 1915 was a combined air and naval clash between the Italian airship M.2 Città di Ferrara and Austro-Hungarian Navy L48 seaplane and two military vessels near the coast of north-eastern Italy as a part of Adriatic campaign of World War I. The airship was chased after a bomb raid on Fiume (present-day Rijeka) by an air and navy patrol while the Austro-Hungarian aircraft crew was able to destroy the airship in the air.

zh.s: 1915年6月8日，意大利飞艇M.2“费拉拉城”号与奥匈帝国海军L48水上飞机及两艘军舰在意大利东北海岸附近发生空海交战，这是第一次世界大战亚得里亚海战役的一部分。意大利飞艇此前轰炸了阜姆（今克罗地亚里耶卡），随后遭奥匈空海巡逻队追击。奥匈机组人员最终击落了飞艇。

zh.s: 阿尔苏夫战斗发生于1918年6月8日，是第一次世界大战西奈及巴勒斯坦战役的一部分，交战双方为大英帝国与奥斯曼帝国、德意志帝国和奥匈帝国组成的同盟国。英军参战部队为第21（巴雷利）旅，包括黑卫队第2营、向导步兵第1营、旁遮普第29团和廓尔喀步枪第1营第8连。

en.s: The 1924 Campeonato de Portugal Final was the final match of the 1923–24 Campeonato de Portugal, the 3rd season of the Portuguese football cup. en.s: The Northern Expedition was a military campaign launched by the National Revolutionary Army (NRA) of the Kuomintang (KMT) against the Beiyang government and other regional warlords in 1926. The purpose of the campaign was to reunify China, which had become fragmented in the aftermath of the 1911 Revolution. The expedition was led by Generalissimo Chiang Kai-shek, and was divided into two phases.
en.n: Second Northern Expedition: The National Revolutionary Army captures Beijing, whose name is changed to Beiping ("Northern Peace").

en.t: Margaret Bondfield is appointed Minister of Labour. She is the first woman appointed to the Cabinet of the United Kingdom
en.s: Margaret Grace Bondfield (17 March 1873 – 16 June 1953) was a British Labour Party politician, trade unionist and women's rights activist. She became the first female cabinet minister, and the first woman to be a privy counsellor in the UK, when she was appointed Minister of Labour in the Labour government of 1929–31. She had earlier become the first woman to chair the General Council of the Trades Union Congress (TUC).

en.s: Operation Juno (Unternehmen Juno) was a sortie by a German Kriegsmarine flotilla on 8 June 1940, into the Norwegian Sea during the Norwegian Campaign. The sortie was intended to help the German Army to drive the Allies out of northern Norway and to recapture Narvik. The German battleships Scharnhorst and Gneisenau sank the British aircraft carrier HMS Glorious and it two destroyer escorts HMS Acasta and HMS Ardent while detached from the flotilla.

In spring 1943, a wave of successes demonstrated the rise of the Greek Resistance against the Axis powers, particularly the Italians; large areas of the mountainous interior of the country were effectively liberated.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Portugal on 8 June 1958, during the authoritarian Estado Novo regime led by Prime Minister António de Oliveira Salazar. Incumbent President Francisco Craveiro Lopes had clashed with Salazar and did not seek another term, neither as candidate of the regime or for the opposition, which deemed the incumbent president capable of winning the race. zh.s: VASP 168号班机是一架注册号为PP-SRK的波音727-212客机，原定从圣保罗飞往巴西福塔莱萨。1982年6月8日，飞机在下降飞往福塔莱萨时撞上山坡，机上137人全部遇难。此次空难仍是20世纪巴西航空事故中死亡人数最多的一起，也是巴西航空事故史上死亡人数第三多的一起，仅次于戈尔航空1907号班机和TAM航空3054号班机空难。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Nauru on 8 June 2013. After Parliament was dissolved on 1 March, the elections were set for 6 April. en.s: On May 4, 2019, the city of San Antonio, Texas held an election to choose the next mayor of San Antonio. The election was a nonpartisan blanket primary. As no candidate secured a majority of the vote (50% of all votes cast +1), a runoff was held on June 8, 2019, between the two top candidates, incumbent mayor Ron Nirenberg and San Antonio City Councilman Greg Brockhouse.
